standard.summary: 训练时随机丢弃 LoRA 的部分 rank 维度，类似于 Dropout 的正则化效果。默认 0（不丢弃）。
standard.effect: 设为 0.1 = 每步随机丢弃 10% 的 rank 维度。增加正则化，降低对特定 rank 方向的依赖，有助于泛化。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集小但 rank 较高（>32）时可开启（0.05~0.1）防止过拟合。
standard.avoidWhen: 低 rank（<=8）时 dropout 会过度损失有限的表达能力。高 dropout 率（>0.3）容易训练不稳定。

standard_en.summary: Randomly drops some of the LoRA's rank dimensions during training, regularising much as dropout does. Default 0 (no dropping).
standard_en.effect: 0.1 drops 10% of the rank dimensions each step. It regularises, reduces reliance on particular rank directions, and helps generalisation.
standard_en.whenToUse: Worth turning on (0.05-0.1) against overfitting when the dataset is small but the rank is fairly high (>32).
standard_en.avoidWhen: At low rank (<=8) dropout wastes what little expressiveness there is. A high rate (>0.3) easily destabilises training.

advanced.principle: 每个 forward 随机生成 mask，将选中的 rank 维度清零（Bernoulli 采样）。等价于训练了一系列不同 rank 子集，提高泛化性。
advanced.tradeoffs: rank dropout 增加训练随机性，配合较高 LR 才能充分采样各 rank 子集；过低 LR 时 dropout 效果不明显。

advanced_en.principle: Each forward pass randomly generates a mask and zeroes the selected rank dimensions (Bernoulli sampling). This is equivalent to training a series of different rank subsets, improving generalization.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Rank dropout increases training randomness; a relatively high LR is needed to sample the rank subsets adequately, and at too low an LR the dropout effect is not evident.
